list.name: agent
list.label: Agente
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT agent FROM token_usage ORDER BY agent

panels.title: A1 · Llamadas fallidas (%)
panels.description: Llamadas registradas, reparaciones incluidas. status != success. No es porcentaje de turnos fallidos. Solo los fallos persistidos en token_usage son observables.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE status<>'success')/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS failed_calls_pct FROM token_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})

panels.title: Tokens totales
panels.description: Tokens del periodo, fallos y reparaciones incluidos. No es saldo de cuota: la ventana de cuotas puede variar por usuario.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(total_tokens) AS tokens FROM token_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})

panels.title: Coste conocido y cobertura
panels.description: NULL significa precio desconocido, no gratis. No dividir este coste entre planes para afirmar coste de generación.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(cost_usd) AS known_cost_usd,count(*) AS calls,100.0*count(cost_usd)/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS price_coverage_pct FROM token_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})

panels.title: A1 · Fiabilidad por agente y modelo
panels.description: Latencias positivas registradas por llamada, no tiempo percibido ni histograma de turnos. Algunos fallos sin latencia se excluyen del percentil; columna timed_calls explicita cobertura.

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent,model,count(*) AS calls,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status<>'success') AS failed_calls,100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE status<>'success')/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS failure_pct,count(*) FILTER (WHERE latency_ms>0) AS timed_calls,percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) FILTER (WHERE latency_ms>0) AS p50_ms,percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) FILTER (WHERE latency_ms>0) AS p95_ms FROM token_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) GROUP BY agent,model ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: A1 · Estados y límite de salida
panels.description: llm_output_limit es límite de salida del proveedor. No equivale a cuota del usuario ni a timeout.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour',created_at) AS time,agent || ' / ' || status AS metric,count(*) AS calls FROM token_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1,agent,status ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latencia del entrenador por acción/fase · p50/p95 (ms)
panels.description: Logs training_latency; fases anidadas, NO sumar percentiles ni interpretar como turnos completos. Filtro de agente no aplica aquí: son fases del entrenador. Solo fases exitosas; SQL separa llamadas LLM por agente/modelo.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {service_name="fitcoach-ia",environment="$environment"} |= "training_latency " | regexp `training_latency action=(?P<action>[^ ]+) phase=(?P<phase>[^ ]+) result=(?P<result>[^ ]+) duration_ms=(?P<duration_ms>[0-9.]+)` | result="ok" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__interval]) by (action,phase)

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="fitcoach-ia",environment="$environment"} |= "training_latency " | regexp `training_latency action=(?P<action>[^ ]+) phase=(?P<phase>[^ ]+) result=(?P<result>[^ ]+) duration_ms=(?P<duration_ms>[0-9.]+)` | result="ok" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__interval]) by (action,phase)
